messages:
Aisha Malik: Quick sync — hosted spend vs commit for AcmeCorp. Saw a ~3.2x burst overnight; budget commit is $12k/mo, estimated burn now at $15.6k. Flagged as anomaly :warning:. Who can dig into request patterns?
Jordan Patel: @Aisha Malik thanks — saw the alert this morning. Are those all text-gen calls or embeddings? :eyes:
Priya Shah: looks like text-gen heavy. I pulled a quick sample from the telemetry: 60% of tokens from /v1/generate on key acme-prod-key-01, spikes around 02:14-02:40 UTC.
Marco Li: Ops-bot shows a deploy around 02:10 from acme-stage -> prod. Could be staging jobs hitting prod key.
Aisha Malik: ugh. @Marco Li pls confirm if their CI rotated creds or mispointed. If this is a staging misroute, we should offer a one-time credit and fix pointers.
Jordan Patel: I'll ping the customer (threaded email) but want to be sure before messaging. Renewal in 5 weeks — this will affect negotiation if left unresolved.
Priya Shah: quick query I ran (sample):
```
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tok, COUNT(*) as calls
FROM logs
WHERE api_key = 'acme-prod-key-01' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-18T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tok DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
Result: `/v1/generate` -> 4.1M tokens, `/v1/embed` -> 120k tokens.
Marco Li: Confirmed — their staging cluster accidentally used prod key after a recent infra template change. SRE rolled back the template at 03:05 UTC.
Aisha Malik: OK — action: 1) Offer prorated credit for the accidental burst, 2) Lockdown template and add a check to prevent prod-key in staging, 3) Follow up with onboarding doc update. Who owns each?
Jordan Patel: I can own the customer comms (1). Will draft suggested language: apologize, explain root cause, propose credit and mitigation.
Priya Shah: I'll own the SDK/template change + PR for the check (2). Quick fix pushed, will open a ticket to add a CI gate.
Marco Li: I'll file the incident postmortem and add the template rollback note (3). Also recommend adding a rate-limiter on keys during early-stage onboarding.
Aisha Malik: Good — can we also add a quick watch rule to the account: threshold = commit * 1.1 for 24h rolling? If exceeded, auto-notify CS and set a temporary soft-quota.
ops-bot: Automatic rule created: account: acme | threshold: 110% of commit | alert: cs-team, eng-oncall. Incident ID: INC-20260318-232.
Jordan Patel: ETA to send customer note? I can draft today, aim to send in morning timezone.
Priya Shah: PR will be up in ~2 hrs. I'll link deploy and the test verifying no staging leak.
Marco Li: Postmortem skeleton done, adding timeline & mitigations.
Aisha Malik: Thanks team. I'll mark renewal risk as "watch" for now (not at-risk) but if we see repeated spikes will escalate. Please drop any doc links in this thread. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jordan Patel: Draft saved here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/acme-credit-draft (shareable).
Priya Shah: Template PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/templates/pull/412
Marco Li: Postmortem in progress: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/INC-20260318-232
Aisha Malik: Closing loop: credit approved up to $2k, pending final numbers from billing. I will update customer after billing confirms.
Jordan Patel: thx :thumbsup:
Priya Shah: noted. Will add onboarding note to prevent recurrence.
Marco Li: tagging @ops-bot for final archive.
ops-bot: Thread archived to incident INC-20260318-232.
